FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Elegant Spaces Interior Design specializes in providing personalized residential interior design services that focus on enhancing the aesthetic and functional aspects of clients' living spaces. Our core operations include comprehensive design consultations, space planning, color scheme development, and the selection of furnishings and decorative items. We pride ourselves on maintaining strong relationships with reputable vendors and suppliers to ensure that our clients receive high-quality products tailored to their individual needs. 

Furthermore, we adhere to strict documentation practices, including formal contracts and project documentation, to ensure transparency and accountability throughout the design process. Our team employs secure digital storage solutions to protect sensitive client information and complies with all local licensing and regulatory requirements in our design recommendations. By offering a blend of creativity, attention to detail, and a commitment to client satisfaction, Elegant Spaces Interior Design strives to create beautiful and functional environments for our clients while operating strictly within the boundaries of interior decorating without engaging in any construction or structural modifications.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in general construction or structural remodeling, including demolition or load-bearing modifications, and confirms that it does not handle or store hazardous materials such as lead paint, asbestos, or industrial chemicals. Additionally, we do not perform electrical, plumbing, or HVAC work beyond decorative fixture installation, nor do we provide services for industrial or large-scale commercial properties.
